purpose: Retratos limpos para diagramação do GDD, preservando identidade e pose da v5

portraits.prompt: Edit the provided tophia character reference sheet into ONE clean full-body character portrait for a game design document. Portrait aspect ratio 3:4. Keep ONLY the large main FRONT character and their EXACT established pose, identity, anatomy, outfit, expression, colors and painted 3D concept style. Tophia is the smiling short black haired woman in fully enclosing orange stone knight armor, only head exposed, one leg tucked up, other on the ground, peace sign beside her eye, other hand down. Remove ALL lettering, palette swatches, back view, equipment closeups and supplemental studies. Uniform warm ivory background, subtle ground shadow only. Entire main figure fully inside frame with comfortable margin; no cut limbs or weapon. No new elements, no typography. This is portrait cleanup of the existing approved design, not a redesign.
